skill.name: receiving-code-review
skill.description: Guides agents to assess code review comments before implementation, ask for clarification, verify against the codebase, and push back when feedback is unsound.
skill.summary: Evaluate code review feedback before acting, with clarification, verification, and focused implementation.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incomplete, or wrong for the current codebase. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code verify, prioritize, and respond with technical rigor.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to read complete feedback before reacting.
Prompts clarification when any review item is unclear.
Encourages verification against existing code, tests, platform support, and usage.
Defines when to push back on technically incorrect or unnecessary suggestions.
Provides response patterns for GitHub review threads and inline comments.
limitations: Does not perform code analysis by itself.
Requires access to the relevant repository and review context.
Cannot decide product priorities without human direction.
May need tests or documentation to verify reviewer claims.

use_cases.title: Handle Ambiguous Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Separate clear requests from unclear items before changing code, then ask focused clarification questions.

use_cases.title: Verify External Reviewer Suggestions
use_cases.description: Check whether a suggested change fits the current codebase, platform support, and existing behavior.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Review Fixes
use_cases.description: Prioritize blocking issues, simple fixes, and complex refactors while testing each change separately.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify One Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me evaluate this code review comment before I act: [paste comment]. Restate the technical request, list checks I should make, and identify clarification questions.

prompt_templates.title: Sort Review Items
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these numbered feedback items: [paste list]. Separate clear items from unclear ones, flag risky assumptions, and propose an implementation order.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Refactor Request
prompt_templates.prompt: A reviewer asked for a larger refactor: [paste request]. Compare it with current codebase constraints, identify unnecessary scope risks, and draft a concise response.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Technical Pushback
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this disputed review thread: [paste context]. Build a technical argument with evidence needed, tests to run, and a final reply recommendation.

output_examples.input: A reviewer says to remove a compatibility path, but the supported platform range is unclear.
output: Checks the deployment target and API support before changing code.
If compatibility is required, drafts a concise pushback with the evidence needed.
If compatibility is not required, recommends removing the path and testing the affected flow.

output_examples.input: A review lists six requested fixes, but two items are vague.
output: Identifies the four clear items and the two unclear items.
Recommends asking for clarification before partial implementation.
Explains that related review items can conflict when handled separately.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks for metrics tracking, exports, and filters on an endpoint with no known callers.
output: Recommends checking real usage before adding the feature.
Flags unnecessary scope if the endpoint is unused.
Suggests asking whether to remove the endpoint or confirm hidden usage.

best_practices: Read all review items before changing code.
Verify each suggestion against current behavior, tests, and platform constraints.
Implement one item at a time and test each change.
anti_patterns: Accepting every review comment without checking it.
Starting partial fixes while some requested items remain unclear.
Using performative agreement instead of concise technical status.

faq.question: Is this skill only for pull requests?
faq.answer: No. It applies to pull requests, code review comments, teammate feedback, and external review notes.

faq.question: Will it reject reviewer feedback automatically?
faq.answer: No. It asks the agent to verify the feedback, then implement, clarify, or push back with evidence.

faq.question: Can it help write GitHub review replies?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives concise reply patterns and reminds agents to answer inline review threads when appropriate.

faq.question: Does it replace tests?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly encourages testing each fix and checking for regressions.

faq.question: Why does it discourage gratitude-heavy replies?
faq.answer: It keeps review responses focused on verified technical action, status, and evidence.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
